Legitimate rubric mismatches where Glory and Theotokion come from different sources at different tones — not bugs. (a) 02-21 (Cheesefare Sat → Forgiveness Sun): Menaion Glory 'for the Forerunner' (Tone 2) paired with Triodion 'Adam ate the forbidden fruit' Theotokion (Tone 6) — the pre-Lenten Triodion provides its own Now-Theotokion at its authored tone, distinct from the menaion saint's Glory. (b) 06-13 (NA Saints Sun): Menaion Glory tone 4 paired with the saint's own order=-1 Theotokion tone 5 — saint's-own Theotokion legitimately at a different tone than the saint's doxastichon. Both cases the rule is too strict; the tone-match rubric applies to Octoechos-appendix Theotokion lookups, not to Triodion/Pentecostarion or saint's-own Theotokia. Fix path (future): tighten D4 to recognize saint's-own (menaion order=-1) Theotokion source and skip; for Triodion-Theotokion-after-Menaion-Glory pattern, similar source-aware skip needed. addedAt 2026-06-19.

Annunciation Matins Aposticha is a Great Feast (Lord's feast) whose Aposticha structure renders a combined Glory+Now + single feast sticheron (no weekday-shape stichera blend). Real edge case, not a regression. addedAt 2026-06-18.
